# vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests

## Overview

Tests that SPIR-V float-control execution modes (`DenormPreserve`, `DenormFlushToZero`, `SignedZeroInfNanPreserve`, `RoundingModeRTE`, `RoundingModeRTZ`) can be used without requiring the `VK_KHR_shader_float_controls` extension. The tests use SPIR-V 1.4 build options and validate either the `VK_KHR_spirv_1_4` path or the Vulkan 1.2 path in [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L202-L216). Tests run in compute pipeline only.

## Role

Implementation file

## Source

- [vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L240)

## Registration Hierarchy

```text
spirv_assembly.instruction.compute.float_controls_extensionless
├── spirv1p4
└── vulkan1_2
```

## Test Families

### spirv1p4 — SPIR-V 1.4 float controls tests

Tests float-control execution modes enabled through SPIR-V 1.4 and requires `VK_KHR_spirv_1_4` in [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L206-L211). Contains 15 test cases covering five execution modes by three float widths. Test names follow the `fp{width}_{featureName}` pattern built in [`createFloatControlsExtensionlessGroup()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L264-L273).

### vulkan1_2 — Vulkan 1.2 float controls tests

Tests the same float-control execution modes through Vulkan 1.2 support, without requiring `VK_KHR_spirv_1_4`, as checked in the non-SPIR-V-1.4 branch of [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L212-L216). Contains the same 15 generated case names as `spirv1p4`, generated by the shared loops in [`createFloatControlsExtensionlessGroup()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L258-L276).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Values | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| SPIR-V version path | `spirv1p4`, `vulkan1_2` | How float controls are enabled, from the [`spirVersions`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L240-L243) array |
| Float width | 16, 32, 64 | Bit width of the float type, from [`floatingPointWideness`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L242-L244) |
| Execution mode | `denorm_preserve`, `denorm_flush_to_zero`, `signed_zero_inf_nan_preserve`, `rounding_mode_rte`, `rounding_mode_rtz` | Float-control feature under test, from the [`fpFeatures`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L244-L254) table |

## Support / Feature Requirements

- **VK_KHR_spirv_1_4** extension — required for the `spirv1p4` group in [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L206-L211).
- **Vulkan 1.2** — required for the `vulkan1_2` group in [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L212-L216).
- **VK_KHR_shader_float16_int8** extension with `shaderFloat16` feature — required for FP16 tests in [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L218-L224).
- **shaderFloat64** core feature — required for FP64 tests in [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L226-L229).
- Corresponding `VkPhysicalDeviceFloatControlsProperties` property must be true for each tested feature/width combination through [`getFloatControlsProperty()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L231-L232).
- SPIR-V version 1.4 build options are used in [`initPrograms()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L195-L203).

## Verification Methods

- **Compute IO verification**: Uses `verifyOutput` from `SpvAsmComputeShaderInstance` through the instance setup in [`SpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessInstance`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L172-L179).
- The shader performs `OpFNegate` on random float inputs; expected outputs are the negated inputs, generated in [`SpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessInstance`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L96-L100).
- Each test uses 64 random float elements in the range `1.0` to `100.0`, seeded by the test-name hash and base seed in [`SpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessInstance`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L88-L97).

## Notes

- This file tests that float-control capabilities work without the `VK_KHR_shader_float_controls` extension, using only SPIR-V 1.4 or Vulkan 1.2 paths as selected by [`spirv14`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L258-L273).
- The shader is minimal: it only performs `OpFNegate` on input data, serving as a smoke test that the execution mode is accepted and the shader compiles/runs correctly; expected output generation is visible in [`SpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessInstance`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L96-L100).
- The [`SpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessCase`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L185-L193) class handles both [`initPrograms()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L195-L203) and [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L206-L233).
- Compute-only tests are registered by [`createFloatControlsExtensionlessGroup()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmFloatControlsExtensionlessTests.cpp#L240-L276) under the compute instruction tree.
